verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's own feature docs say it automatically creates unique Zoom rooms for new events, adds Google Meet links to calendar events, and attaches Whereby rooms to invites. That covers the core of auto-generating a video link for each booking with Zoom and Meet. missing for 10: evidence of Microsoft Teams support, any native video option, in-depth setup docs beyond feature bullets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)

citations.quote: Automatically create unique Zoom rooms for new events.
Add Meet links to your Google Calendar events.
Attach Whereby meeting rooms to calendar invites.
